complianceNote: Playground (tryplayground.com) is a real, live company. This clone's own NOTICE.md (project root) already documents that public/assets/ - including five named customer organizations' logos, photographs of identifiable children and teachers, and hand-drawn portraits of named individuals - is gitignored and NOT committed to this repository for exactly this reason. This design-repo's asset-role guidance below carries that same posture forward: no generator using this design-repo may fabricate, reproduce, or approximate any real Playground customer logo, any real customer/employee/child photograph, or any real Playground product-screenshot UI. Where the source site places one of these, the correct generation behavior is a clearly-synthetic placeholder, never a fabrication presented as real.

customer-logo.description: A named third-party organization's logo mark (e.g. the five customers in proof.logo-ticker, proof.review-wall's named quotes).
customer-logo.guidance: Never generate a logo resembling a real, identifiable organization. If a customer-logo slot is needed for a new generated page, use a generic placeholder mark (a neutral wordmark/monogram) clearly not attributable to any real company - do not invent a plausible-sounding fictional company logo styled to pass as real, either.

customer-photo.description: A photograph of a real, identifiable customer, employee, child, or teacher (proof.testimonial-band, proof.customer-stories, proof.pull-quote, hand-drawn portraits in /about, /customers, /careers).
customer-photo.guidance: Never generate a photorealistic image implying a real identifiable person. If illustrative art is needed in this role's place, use a clearly non-photographic, non-identifying illustration style (the source itself uses hand-drawn illustration for some of these slots already).

product-screenshot.description: A real screenshot of the Playground product UI (hero tab-rail stage, changelog release images, /solutions feature-row media, feature.grid-sections card art).
product-screenshot.guidance: Never generate a screenshot presented as a real product UI. A generated page needing this role should use an abstract/illustrative placeholder that does not imply real functionality or real UI chrome belonging to Playground's actual product.

decorative-illustration.description: Hand-drawn decorative shapes/patterns with no identifiable subject (squiggles, sun-bursts, plaques - see public/assets/img/about/*).
decorative-illustration.guidance: Safe to generate new decorative art in this role, matching the site's hand-drawn illustration style, since it carries no real-identity or real-brand content.

icon.description: UI iconography (nav icons, dot indicators, chevrons).
icon.guidance: Safe to generate new icon art following the primitive icon contract's sizing.

rive-canvas-art.description: WebGL2 Rive state-machine animation painted into a canvas (feature.grid-sections wide cards). Not a static image asset.
rive-canvas-art.guidance: This role is not a generatable static asset - it is bound to a real .riv file per RiveArt.jsx. A generated PageSpec should not attempt to invent new Rive content; treat existing rive-canvas-art bindings as fixed.
